```{r}
library(gtsummary)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(gt)
```



```{r}

source("config.R")  # knitr runs from R/
load(file.path(data_dir, "AB468b_data_noPHI_shared_randomForests.RData"))

# Data preparation
vars <- c(
  "age_deid","racenci_new","menopht_2cat","famhx_c","bmi_c","mammtype_new",
  "density_c","prvmos_c","mossince1stdx","mossinceprvsurvmm_cat",
  "mod1_new","dxage_deid","dxyear","hist1_new","stage1","grade1_c",
  "erplus1","srg1_new","rt_new","adjthrpy_1"
)

catVars <- c(
  "racenci_new","menopht_2cat","famhx_c","mammtype_new","density_c",
  "mossinceprvsurvmm_cat","mod1_new","hist1_new","stage1","grade1_c",
  "erplus1","srg1_new","rt_new","adjthrpy_1"
)

# Create filtered datasets
df_recall <- filter(data_exam_analytic_deid, FP_recall == 1) #updated to FPrecall and not FP recall only
df_biop        <- filter(data_exam_analytic_deid, FP_biop == 1)    
df_none        <- filter(data_exam_analytic_deid, FP_recall == 0, FP_biop == 0)
df_all         <- data_exam_analytic_deid
```

```{r}
# Create individual summary tables
tbl_recall <- df_recall %>%
  select(all_of(vars)) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    type = all_of(catVars) ~ "categorical",
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(all_continuous() ~ 0, all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing",
    missing_stat = "{N_miss} ({p_miss}%)"
  )

tbl_biop <- df_biop %>%
  select(all_of(vars)) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    type = all_of(catVars) ~ "categorical",
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(all_continuous() ~ 0, all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing",
    missing_stat = "{N_miss} ({p_miss}%)"
  )

tbl_none <- df_none %>%
  select(all_of(vars)) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    type = all_of(catVars) ~ "categorical",
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(all_continuous() ~ 0, all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing",
    missing_stat = "{N_miss} ({p_miss}%)"
  )

tbl_all <- df_all %>%
  select(all_of(vars)) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    type = all_of(catVars) ~ "categorical",
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(all_continuous() ~ 0, all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing",
    missing_stat = "{N_miss} ({p_miss}%)"
  )

# Merge tables
table1_merged <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(tbl_recall, tbl_biop, tbl_none, tbl_all),
  tab_spanner = c(
    paste0("**False positive recall only**<br>(N=", nrow(df_recall), ", ", 
           round(nrow(df_recall)/nrow(df_all)*100, 2), "%)"),
    paste0("**False positive biopsy**<br>(N=", nrow(df_biop), ", ", 
           round(nrow(df_biop)/nrow(df_all)*100, 2), "%)"),
    paste0("**Non-events**<br>(N=", nrow(df_none), ", ", 
           round(nrow(df_none)/nrow(df_all)*100, 2), "%)"),
    "**Overall**"
  )
) %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Risk Factors**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ "**Table 1: Distribution of risk factors stratified by false positive outcome**")
```

```{r}
table1_merged %>% 
  as_gt() %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 10,
    data_row.padding = px(1),

    grand_summary_row.padding = px(1),

    source_notes.padding = px(1),
    row_group.padding = px(1)
  )
```
